about: Security advisories Security > Your stack matches against what serves each site (skald/advisories.py). Shipped with each release; docs/DATA-CONTRACT-SECURITY.md says how to add one. Facts only from the vendor's own advisory.

advisories.title: PHP: unauthenticated remote code execution
advisories.no_fix_words: PHP 8.1 and older have no official release with the fix; only source backports exist for 7.4, 8.0 and 8.1.
advisories.affected: Sites run by PHP-FPM, mod_php (the highest risk), php-cgi, FrankenPHP or LiteSpeed.
advisories.summary: A flaw in PHP lets anyone on the internet run code on the server, without signing in.
advisories.action: Update PHP to the fixed release of its branch, then restart PHP (the FPM pool or the web server).
mitigations: Set memory_limit=-1 through php_admin_value in the pool or virtual host.
Set post_max_size to 8M (32M on a site that takes uploads).
Set session.upload_progress.enabled=0, then restart the PHP workers.
At the proxy, limit the request size, the number of form fields and the number of multipart parts.
advisories.mitigations_note: These reduce the exposure; they do not make a site safe. Update.

firewall_notes.words: Cloudflare says it deployed firewall (WAF) rules against php2shell on 21 October 2026 at 03:02 UTC, on every plan with its WAF, the Free plan included, and that customers should patch even with these protections.

advisories.title: Node.js October 2026 security releases
advisories.no_fix_words: Node.js branches that have reached end of life get no fix: move to a supported branch (22, 24 or 26).
advisories.affected: Every Node.js server on a branch below the fixed release, a Next.js site's included.
advisories.summary: The most serious flaw, a Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-111497), can let a crafted request run code on the server; others are DNS NUL truncation, TLS hostname verification and keep-alive issues.
advisories.action: Update Node.js to the fixed release of its branch, rebuild the app's image if it runs in a container, and restart it.
